answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with costly stake and slashing. Each agent locks a bond to earn a beacon of trust, so minting a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand bonds and paying upfront. Every action appears in a public mirror of the ledger, so one operator running a violet army of clones leaves correlated timing and funding trails. Peers then slash the bonds of any ring caught double-voting, turning the attack into a guaranteed loss.
